name: atom-audit
description: Produce ATOM_AUDIT.md table auditing every atom component against COMPONENT_GUIDELINES.md (memo, callbacks, inline styles, touch target, a11y, reduced motion). Use when 2-4 weeks have passed since last audit, 5+ new atoms shipped, or COMPONENT_GUIDELINES has a new normative rule. Do not use when no atoms exist (run design-bootstrap first), for a single atom (use design-spec-review instead), or for 6 or more atoms (use atom-audit-fleet).
